problem_summary.summary: Return the value visible at the rightmost position of each tree level, ordered from the root level downward.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: the root of a binary tree. Return an integer list containing one visible value per non-empty level; an empty tree returns an empty list.

brute_force.explanation: Visit each node in root-right-left order. The first node encountered at each depth is that level's rightmost visible node.
brute_force.correctness_idea: At every depth, right-first depth-first traversal reaches the rightmost existing node before any node to its left. Recording only the first visit at that depth therefore records exactly the right-side view.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n) — every node is visited once.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(h) auxiliary recursion stack, where h is tree height; O(h) output values.

optimized.explanation: Run breadth-first search by fixed-size levels and append the last node processed at each level.
optimized.correctness_idea: The queue processes each level from left to right. Its final node at a level is precisely the rightmost node present there, including when that position is occupied only by a left-subtree node.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n) — each node enters and leaves the queue once.
optimized.space_complexity: O(w) auxiliary for the queue, where w is the maximum level width; O(h) output values.

steps.condition: The root is the only node in this level.
steps.action: Append 8 and enqueue its existing children left to right.

steps.condition: Node 12 is the last node processed at this level.
steps.action: Append 12 and queue the existing right children 6 and 14.

steps.condition: 14 is the last existing node on this level.
steps.action: Append 14 and finish after the queue empties.

edge_cases.handling: The BFS returns an empty list; the DFS records no depth.

edge_cases.case: Only one node at a level
edge_cases.handling: That node is appended as the level's visible value.

edge_cases.case: A level has no right child on its far edge
edge_cases.handling: The rightmost existing node is still recorded, even if it belongs to a left subtree.
